g.text: Alignment improves renewal; some information is still lost
Three reconstruction boundaries | one fixed guide | separate founder cohorts
Each cohort: 8 blocks, 4 paired lives per block, 2 supplied pattern roles.
Bars: reported pointwise 95% block-bootstrap intervals. No cohort pooling or new inference.
A positive primary does not imply lossless renewal. The D140 pooled copy contrast is unresolved.
